skill.oldrepublic.node.force_push.name: Force Push
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_push.desc: Gather the Force and release it as a wave of pressure that throws enemies back. Hold to charge, release to push. Known since the Awakening.
skill.oldrepublic.node.push_repulse_wave: Push bursts out in a wide arc that staggers everything it catches. Short reach, best when surrounded.
skill.oldrepublic.node.push_focused_blas: Push narrows to a tight lance of force that hurls one target far; a full charge slams them into walls for damage.
skill.oldrepublic.node.push_deflecting_p: A quick ring of pressure around you that turns aside incoming bolts and arrows. Shorter cooldown.
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_pull.name: Force Pull
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_pull.desc: Reach out and drag a creature, an enemy or a loose item toward you. A thrown weapon is yanked from the hand.
skill.oldrepublic.node.pull_disarm.name: Disarming Pull
skill.oldrepublic.node.pull_disarm.desc: Pull tears the weapon from an armed foe's grip: they cannot fire or guard for a few seconds.
skill.oldrepublic.node.pull_reel.name: Reel In
skill.oldrepublic.node.pull_reel.desc: Pull drags the target all the way to your feet, staggered. Your next strike on them hits harder.
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_jump.name: Force Jump
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_jump.desc: Gather the Force in your legs and leap far higher and further than any body could. Hold to charge, release to jump. Landings are cushioned.
skill.oldrepublic.node.jump_crushing_des: Land from a great height and the impact staggers and hurts everything around you.
skill.oldrepublic.node.jump_soaring_leap: Leaps carry further, and holding Jump in the air lets you glide down while energy lasts.
skill.oldrepublic.node.deep_reserves.des: Your well of Force Energy runs deeper. More maximum energy per rank.
skill.oldrepublic.node.quickened_flow.de: The Force returns to you faster: more energy regeneration per rank, and it starts sooner after use.
skill.oldrepublic.node.unbound.name: Unbound
skill.oldrepublic.node.unbound.desc: Without a master's code to answer to, the Universal powers come easier: cheaper and quicker to recover. Fades on any path.
skill.oldrepublic.node.saber_lunge.name: Lunge
skill.oldrepublic.node.saber_lunge.desc: Sprint and strike at a foe just out of reach: you close the distance in a heartbeat and hit hard on arrival.
skill.oldrepublic.node.saber_throw.name: Saber Throw
skill.oldrepublic.node.saber_throw.desc: Hurl your lit blade in an arc that cuts through what it meets and returns to your hand.
skill.oldrepublic.node.throw_ricochet.de: The thrown blade glances from one target to the next before returning.
skill.oldrepublic.node.throw_rending_arc: A slower, heavier throw that cuts deeper and staggers what it strikes.
skill.oldrepublic.node.steady_guard.name: Steady Guard
skill.oldrepublic.node.steady_guard.desc: Your guard tires more slowly. More saber stamina per rank.
skill.oldrepublic.node.riposte.name: Riposte
skill.oldrepublic.node.riposte.desc: After a parry, your next hit within a moment strikes much harder.
skill.oldrepublic.node.deflection_contro: Bolts you block without a parry fly back close to where you look, instead of anywhere.
skill.oldrepublic.node.form_soresu.name: Form III: Soresu
skill.oldrepublic.node.form_soresu.desc: The defender's form: wider guard, longer parry window, less stamina lost. Slightly lighter strikes.
skill.oldrepublic.node.form_ataru.name: Form IV: Ataru
skill.oldrepublic.node.form_ataru.desc: The acrobat's form: faster strikes, longer lunges, punishing aerial attacks. Your guard tires faster.
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_heal.name: Force Heal
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_heal.desc: Channel the Light to close your wounds. Slows you while you hold it; a hard blow breaks your focus.
skill.oldrepublic.node.heal_shared_light: Healing reaches allies near you as well, at some extra cost.
A long, unbroken heal leaves a ward that absorbs the next blows.
skill.oldrepublic.node.centered_mind.des: A quiet mind reads the blade sooner: a longer parry window per rank.
skill.oldrepublic.node.calm_focus.name: Calm Focus
skill.oldrepublic.node.calm_focus.desc: Your energy returns sooner after use and your reserves grow.
skill.oldrepublic.node.guardians_resolve: While you guard, allies close to you take less damage.
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_lightning.d: Channel the dark side as arcs of lightning that burn and shock. Guards block it, at a cost in stamina.
skill.oldrepublic.node.lightning_chain.d: Arcs leap from your target to others nearby.
skill.oldrepublic.node.lightning_consumi: The longer you hold the storm, the harder it bites, and it feeds your energy as it burns.
skill.oldrepublic.node.fury.name: Fury
skill.oldrepublic.node.fury.desc: Pain sharpens you: below half health your saber and Force damage rise per rank.
skill.oldrepublic.node.hungering_dark.de: Every hostile you kill restores some Force Energy.
skill.oldrepublic.node.dread_presence.de: Your heavy attacks put lesser enemies to flight.
skill.oldrepublic.hint.unbound: Granted when you walk your own way
skill.oldrepublic.req.not_busy: Not while a power is active

skill.oldrepublic.hint.force_lift: Taught to Independents by a wayfarer's holocron
skill.oldrepublic.hint.archive_kept: Learned by keeping an Archive holocron

skill.oldrepublic.hint.lord: Granted to a Lord of the Empire
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_sense.name: Force Sense
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_sense.desc: Still yourself and listen. What hides nearby answers as drifting dust: creatures out of sight, veiled stone, old caches, and the pull of holocrons not yet found. Its own key; it never takes a slot.
skill.oldrepublic.node.sense_danger.name: Danger Sense
skill.oldrepublic.node.sense_danger.desc: A prickle at the back of the neck: an enemy winding up an attack behind you, out of sight, is felt before it lands.
skill.oldrepublic.node.sense_seeker.name: Seeker's Sight
skill.oldrepublic.node.sense_seeker.desc: Sense reaches twice as far for holocrons and lingers longer. Pedestals and the caches of old sites glint pale gold.
skill.oldrepublic.node.trailwise.name: Trailwise
skill.oldrepublic.node.trailwise.desc: Long roads teach the body: you land falls more lightly and tire less while running.
skill.oldrepublic.node.relic_lore.name: Relic Lore
skill.oldrepublic.node.relic_lore.desc: You know what the old builders left behind. Holocrons teach you more, and under Sense the mechanisms still waiting for the Force trail pale-gold dust.
skill.oldrepublic.node.hardy.name: Hardy
skill.oldrepublic.node.hardy.desc: Weather, hunger and hard ground have toughened you. More maximum health per rank.
skill.oldrepublic.node.scavenger.name: Scavenger
skill.oldrepublic.node.scavenger.desc: Nothing goes to waste. Fallen troopers and broken sentinels sometimes yield an extra plate, thread or silk.
skill.oldrepublic.node.quiet_step.name: Quiet Step
skill.oldrepublic.node.quiet_step.desc: You move like someone who belongs. Dormant sentinels stir only when you are close, and wary soldiers wait longer before they fire.
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_lift.name: Telekinetic Lift
skill.oldrepublic.node.force_lift.desc: Raise one foe into the air and hold them there, helpless, then let them fall hard. Also shifts rubble and debris. Hold to channel; a heavy blow breaks your grip.
skill.oldrepublic.node.lift_suspend.name: Suspend
skill.oldrepublic.node.lift_suspend.desc: You hold the target far longer, and your allies strike it harder while it hangs.
skill.oldrepublic.node.lift_hurl.name: Hurl
skill.oldrepublic.node.lift_hurl.desc: Releasing the lift throws the target along your aim, hurting it and the first thing it strikes.
skill.oldrepublic.node.archivists_road.d: The Archive's keepers walked far and read the land as they went: Sense recovers faster and Lift costs less.
skill.oldrepublic.node.pathfinders_poise: The poise of one who has walked every road: faster on your feet out of combat, and falls hurt less.
A sentinel's calm: every parry, of a blade or a bolt, restores some Force Energy, and Force Heal costs less.
skill.oldrepublic.node.mending_breath.de: Force Heal also drives out slowness, weakness and poison from everyone it touches.
skill.oldrepublic.node.archivists_ward.d: The Archive's patience steadies your blade: a longer parry window.
skill.oldrepublic.node.knights_vigil.des: While you guard, allies close to you take less damage. The vigil of a Knight of the Watch.
skill.oldrepublic.node.tomb_hunger.name: Hunger of the Tomb
skill.oldrepublic.node.tomb_hunger.desc: Finish what your power began: killing a foe soon after striking it with the Force restores energy.
skill.oldrepublic.node.crackling_grasp.d: Your lightning lingers in the nerves. Its targets stay slowed for a while after the storm ends.
skill.oldrepublic.node.archivists_hunger: Push and Lightning strike harder at foes who are still whole.
skill.oldrepublic.node.lords_dominion.de: When your heavy blow lands, lesser enemies nearby falter and strike weaker for a few seconds. The dominion of a Lord of the Empire.
